description: 在 WhatsApp 對話中使用 nanobot。

setup.docsLabel: 開啟 WhatsApp 設定指南
setup.tryIt: 終端機登入完成後，向已連接的帳戶傳送一則 WhatsApp 私訊。
setup.summary: 使用要執行機器人的 WhatsApp 帳戶掃描二維碼即可完成連接。
steps: 執行下方顯示的 WhatsApp 登入指令。
用手機 WhatsApp 掃描終端機中的二維碼。
登入後返回這裡，啟用 WhatsApp，然後傳送一則私訊測試。

groupWorkspacePresets.label: Group workspace model presets
groupWorkspacePresets.help: Map a group JID to a model preset name; sessions starting in that group use that preset.

dmWorkspace.label: DM workspace
dmWorkspace.help: Absolute path used as the workspace for all DMs when no per-sender entry matches.

dmWorkspaceModelPreset.label: DM workspace model preset
dmWorkspaceModelPreset.help: Model preset name applied to sessions whose first inbound falls in the default DM workspace.

dmWorkspacePresets.label: DM workspace model presets
dmWorkspacePresets.help: Map a sender id to a model preset name; per-sender override of dmWorkspaceModelPreset.

dmWorkspaces.label: DM workspaces
dmWorkspaces.help: Map a sender (phone number, LID, or WhatsApp JID) to an absolute workspace path.
